pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7...a6 8.O-O-O h6 9.Be3 Qc7
pages.notes: Plan 4 had White play Kh1 with the king on c1 and Black ...Kb8 without castling; plan 3 had both sides exchange light-squared bishops for no reason. Rewrote plans 2-4 (the reviewer noted the c6-knight blocks the c7-queen's file).

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7...a6 8.O-O-O h6 9.Bf4
pages.notes: Plan 4 named e6-d5 as a route; plan 2 used a ...b5-b4 route from an empty b5. Rewrote plans 2 and 4 around the f4-bishop's pressure on d6.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7...a6, 9.f3
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...Kh8 before Black has castled. Rewrote plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7...a6, 9.f3 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 4 called the g5-bishop light-squared and said Black aims to exchange it; plan 2 called a pawn storm a minority attack. Rewrote plans 2 and 4 (second wording after a reviewer rejection).

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7...a6, 9.f4 b5
pages.notes: Plan 3 had Black exchange the dark-squared bishop for a knight on f3 that does not exist. Rewrote plan 3 around Bxf6 gxf6 and ...Qb6.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7...a6, 9.f4 Be7 10.Be2 Qc7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3 with no rook able to reach c3 yet. Reworded plan 2; British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7...a6, 9.f4 Be7 10.Nf3 b5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an Nf3-g3 route and a queen on h2. Rewrote plan 1 around 11.Bxf6, since ...Bxf6 drops the d6-pawn to Qxd6.

pages.name: Sicilian: Richter-Rauzer, 7...a6, 9.f4 Be7 10.Nf3 b5 11.Bxf6 gxf6
pages.notes: Plan 4 had a ...Kf8-e7 route and talked of trading the f6-knight that is already gone; plan 2 called the half-open g-file open. Rewrote plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Alekhine Variation, Sicilian
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop still on c8; plan 1 called Bg5 a pin; plan 3 sent the b3-knight to d2 to support e5. Rewrote all four plans around the Classical Dragon setup (Be3, f4, Kh1; ...Be6, ...a5-a4).

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file. Reworded plan 4.
